onboarding.title: Your investor profile
onboarding.saveError: We couldn't save your answers. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.resumed: Welcome back — we kept your earlier answers.

income_stability.title: How steady is your monthly income?

options.very_stable: Very steady — a fixed salary or reliable business income
options.somewhat_stable: Mostly steady, with some ups and downs
options.unstable: Irregular — it changes a lot month to month

investment_horizon.title: When do you think you will need this money back?

loss_tolerance.title: If your investment dropped 15% in one month, what would you do?

options.buy_more: Buy more while the price is low

market_experience.title: Have you invested in shares before?

options.some: A little, or through a mutual fund
options.none: No, this is my first time

investment_goal.title: What do you want this money to do?

options.growth: Grow as much as possible, even with big swings
options.preservation: Keep its value safe from inflation

emergency_savings.title: If you lost your income, how long could your savings cover your expenses?

caps.short_horizon: Because you need this money back within a year, we have kept your profile Conservative. Share prices can fall sharply in the short term, and there may not be time to recover.
caps.sells_on_loss: Because you said you would sell if your investment dropped, we have kept your profile no higher than Moderate. Bigger swings could push you to sell at a loss.
caps.low_emergency_savings: Because your savings would cover less than 3 months of expenses, we have kept your profile no higher than Moderate. Your safety cushion comes before higher-risk investing.

onboarding.loadError: We couldn't load your saved answers. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.draftSaveError: We couldn't save your progress just now. Your answers are still here, and we'll save them again with your next answer.
onboarding.cancelRetake: Cancel and keep my current profile

description.conservative: Protecting your money comes first. You prefer slow, steady gains over risky bets, so InvestIQ will lean towards stable, lower-volatility companies.
description.moderate: You want growth without losing sleep. InvestIQ will balance steady dividend payers with some higher-growth companies.
description.aggressive: You are comfortable with big ups and downs in exchange for higher long-term growth. InvestIQ will include more high-growth, higher-volatility companies.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is your investing snapshot.

prediction.title: AI forecast
prediction.subtitle: From an LSTM price model, with a Random Forest buy/sell/hold signal as a second opinion. Both were trained on liquid KSE-100 stocks and tested on months they never saw.

forecast.up: The model forecasts a {{pct}} rise for the next trading day.
forecast.down: The model forecasts a {{pct}} fall for the next trading day.
forecast.flat: The model forecasts almost no change for the next trading day.

prediction.confidenceHelp: How often forecasts this certain got the direction (up or down) right on past data the model did not train on. It is not a guarantee.
prediction.lowConfidenceIntro: Treat this as a weak signal, not advice:

reason.below_threshold: The chance the direction is right is below {{threshold}}%.
reason.models_disagree: The price forecast and the buy/sell/hold signal point different ways.
reason.no_edge_over_baseline: On past data, this model was not more accurate for {{ticker}} than assuming tomorrow's close equals today's.

prediction.signalHelp: From a Random Forest classifier. Buy means it expects a rise of more than 1% tomorrow, sell a fall of more than 1%, hold anything in between.
prediction.notCoveredTitle: No forecast for this stock yet
prediction.notCovered: There is no forecast for {{ticker}} yet. Forecasts cover the {{stocks}} liquid KSE-100 stocks the model was trained and tested on.
prediction.insufficientData: Insufficient data for a reliable prediction. This stock doesn't have enough trading history yet.
prediction.notReady: No forecast yet. Forecasts are generated after each trading day's close.
prediction.evaluationTitle: How accurate has this model been for {{ticker}}?
prediction.evaluationDirection: From {{start}} to {{end}}, days the model never saw in training, it called the next day's direction right on {{direction}} of days. Always guessing "{{baselineDirection}}" would have been right on {{baseline}}.
prediction.evaluationErrorBeats: Its forecasts were typically off by {{error}} of the price, slightly better than assuming tomorrow's close equals today's.
prediction.evaluationErrorNoEdge: Its forecasts were typically off by {{error}} of the price, no better than assuming tomorrow's close equals today's.
prediction.evaluationSignal: The buy/sell/hold signal was right on {{accuracy}} of days, versus {{baseline}} for always giving the most common answer.
prediction.evaluationNote: Next-day stock moves are very hard to predict from past prices. These numbers are shown so you can judge the forecast yourself.
